title: Kernel-Guided Learning of Lifted Sparse Polynomial Models of Nonlinear Dynamical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.20157v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Polynomial models of dynamical systems enable constructive analysis via sum-of-squares programming. Yet, many physical systems involve non-polynomial nonlinearities which for certain classes of systems may be inferred from the underlying physics even when the exact dynamics are unknown. We show that fitting lifted polynomial models directly to lifted data is problematic, since the exact lifting constraints render the lifted derivatives linearly dependent. Instead, we learn the dynamics in the extended state, i.e., the state together with the known nonlinearities, and obtain the dynamics of the nonlinearities via the exact lifting relations. To avoid the combinatorially large libraries that sparse regression requires when the polynomial degrees are unknown, we propose KINDy, which selects the degree of each component by kernel ridge regression before applying sparse regression to the correspondingly reduced library. translated_title: 非线性动力系统提升稀疏多项式模型的核引导学习
translated_abstract: 动力系统的多项式模型可以通过平方和规划实现构造性分析。然而，许多物理系统涉及非多项式非线性，对于某些类别的系统，即使在精确动力学未知的情况下，也可以从其底层物理规律中推断出这些非线性项。我们证明，直接将提升的多项式模型拟合到提升的数据上是有问题的，因为精确的提升约束会导致提升后的导数线性相关。相反，我们在扩展状态（即系统状态与已知非线性项的组合）中学习动力学，并通过精确的提升关系获得非线性项的动力学。为了避免在多项式次数未知时稀疏回归所需的组合爆炸式的大型候选函数库，我们提出了KINDy方法，该方法先通过核岭回归选择每个分量的多项式次数，再对相应缩减后的函数库应用稀疏回归。我们证明，对于……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出KINDy方法，先利用核岭回归确定各分量的多项式次数以缩减候选函数库，再应用稀疏回归，从而学习含非多项式非线性的动力系统的提升稀疏多项式模型，避免了多项式次数未知时稀疏回归所需的组合爆炸式大型函数库。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes KINDy, which uses kernel ridge regression to select the polynomial degree of each component before applying sparse regression, enabling learning of lifted sparse polynomial models of nonlinear dynamical systems with non-polynomial nonlinearities while avoiding combinatorially large candidate libraries.
